title: frankenia chilensis var. aspera
intro: Frankenia chilensis var. aspera, commonly known as Chilean ash, is a shrub native to South America, particularly in the coastal regions of Chile and Peru. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Chilean ash include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects. Its therapeutic actions also include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and exhibit hepatoprotective properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
